parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is a sliding glass panel of the window, made primarily of glass with a supporting aluminum or PVC frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows light to pass through and can be moved horizontally to open or close the window for ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is another sliding glass panel of the window, similar to the first one, made of glass and framed with aluminum or PVC.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable section that can slide to overlap or uncover the adjacent panel, controlling airflow and access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally along the same track as the other panels.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is the third sliding glass panel of the window, made of glass and framed with aluminum or PVC.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional flexibility in opening configurations and contributes to the overall transparency and ventilation control.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide horizontally within the frame, similar to the other panels.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the window, made of aluminum, providing structural support for the sliding glass panels.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glass panels in place, provides tracks for their movement, and ensures the window’s rigidity and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support structure for the movable panels.
